Using the equation of motion with quadratic drag:

\[
m v\frac{dv}{dh}=mg-kv^2
\]

Terminal velocity satisfies \(mg = k v_t^2\). Integrating from \(v=0\) to \(v=0.95v_t\):

\[
h=\frac{m}{2k}\ln\left(\frac{1}{1-0.95^2}\right)
\]

\[
h=\frac{80}{2(0.27)}\ln\left(\frac{1}{0.0975}\right)
=148.148\ln(10.2564)
\approx 344.87
\]

ANSWER: 344.8745
